findings.summary: Durable GLM egress consent was treated as workload qualification without a Settings-specific capability decision.
findings.requiredCorrection: Require activation-time route qualification for repository writes, shell commands, disposable Postgres, browser resources, and the exact unattended workload; split unsupported verification explicitly.

findings.summary: A repository-only GLM worker lacked accepted bilingual copy and fresh rendered Paper inputs.
findings.requiredCorrection: Provide a secret-screened durable copy/geometry packet and assign final four-frame comparison to a native Paper-capable reviewer.

findings.summary: Checkpoints A-E lacked coherent commit and rollback boundaries.
findings.requiredCorrection: Commit each coherent checkpoint and roll back by preserving or returning to the preceding checkpoint boundary without rewriting history.

findings.summary: Manual screen-reader semantics verification was absent.
findings.requiredCorrection: Verify control/group names, errors, state/version announcements, read-only semantics, and live-region uniqueness in both locales.

findings.summary: The phase command used POSIX environment assignment in a PowerShell repository context.
